minutes.headline: Select Board approved a book peddler's license, a Green Communities appointee and committee assignments; promised a Memorial Day committee.
minutes.summary: The board apologized for the lapse in Memorial Day planning and committed to forming a committee. It heard the DPW director on the reworked Tumulus Road and Townsend Harbor Road intersection, then handled a peddler's license, a Green Communities Task Force appointment, committee liaison assignments, a land grant agent appointment, a land swap ratification, water billing and a traffic count request. Committee reports covered 40B sewer fees, the turf field and a planning board resignation.

votes.motion: Approve the peddler's license for Nicholas for sale of education products, contingent on the state peddler's license
Appoint Mike Conway to the Green Communities Task Force
Appoint Brandon Kibby and Kerry Spidel as the town's agents to file the land grant application
Ratify the quitclaim deed and acceptance of deed for the land swap at 1417 Massachusetts Avenue
Authorize the quarterly water usage billing amounts, amended to cover both
Approve chair signing the MRPC traffic count request for Goodridge Street and Lancaster Avenue
Acknowledge the planning board resignation and accept the other two resignations, with thank-you notes signed by the board

budget_items.what_was_said: Payroll, payroll deduction and accounts payable warrants were read, including a loan payment.
The board signed documents allowing the fourth quarter water usage billing and an adjustment to go out.
The finance committee began looking at user fees and the capital plan for the turf field, due for replacement around 2017.
Plot plans and preliminary Town Hall cost estimates will need some expense, with a budgeted project plan to follow.
A member argued the fees should not be waived or paid from the sewer enterprise fund.

decisions.decision: The board committed to put a Memorial Day committee together by no later than July first.
Committee liaison assignments settled, with the chair taking the school building committee and a new member the MO designate.
The board will organize a meeting of all pertinent bodies on turf field ownership, fees and replacement, after getting a fee and expense report.
The board will prepare a letter of support for the TIP vote, signed by all members.

what_happened.line: The Select Board committed to forming a Memorial Day committee by July first, after apologizing for a lapse in planning for the holiday.
The board approved a peddler's license for sale of education products, contingent on the applicant also holding the state peddler's license.
The board appointed a member to the Green Communities Task Force and settled its committee liaison assignments.
The board named two town agents to file a land grant application and ratified the quitclaim deed for the land swap at 1417 Massachusetts Avenue.
The board authorized quarterly water usage billing, approved a traffic count request for Goodridge Street and Lancaster Avenue, and accepted three resignations.

why_it_matters: Water bills for the fourth quarter were authorized to go out, with an adjustment, so residents on town water should expect them.
The turf field is due for replacement around 2017, and the board plans a meeting on ownership, fees and replacement, so user fees and the capital plan may reach a future budget or Town Meeting vote.
A member argued that sewer privilege fees on a 40B project should not be waived or paid from the sewer enterprise fund. Who pays those fees could affect sewer rates.
watch_next: The Memorial Day committee is due to be formed by July first.
A letter of support for the TIP vote, signed by all members, and a meeting of all pertinent bodies on turf field ownership, fees and replacement, after a fee and expense report.
